processors: AMD EPYC 7773X (64 cores / 128 hardware threads per host)
handoff: Parquet over NFS on the separate 10 GbE network

Milan: native kg head, RAM RDB, in-process WAL in journaled runs
Tinkara: native kg HDB, two native kg subscribers, native kg publisher, separate native kg live and historical quote readers

workload: One fresh archive per configuration, short seed, then three full 60-second days at 3145728 offered trades/s. Day 1 warms the HDB and days 2 and 3 are measured.
metrics: Host NIC and cgroup measurements use samples wholly inside ingest. Tinkara roles share a host NIC. The generated workload requires one WAL data sync per acknowledged publish batch with the WAL enabled.
